The '''LJ-50 Concussion Rifle''' was a heavy field weapon manufactured by [[Arakyd Industries/Legends|Arakyd Industries]], and used in medium to long distance engagements. It utilized a concussive energy charge that imploded on impact and created a 5 meter radius area of effect. Then the gun sent out a burst of energy. This often killed its target. The weapon was sometimes equipped with an EMP bayonet, which was effective at stunning and disabling [[Droid/Legends|droids]], or electrocuting an enemy.

The rifle was often used by commandos in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]], but lower quality copies were manufactured and employed by [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] forces. The rifle was also favored by the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Etain Tur-Mukan]].

==History==
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the weapons were used by [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] mercenaries and slavers.
